# ISO Open Data: a few records

These three files are a few records of ISO Open Data, taken as ISO publishes them: the datasets
`iso_deliverables_metadata`, `iso_technical_committees` and `iso_ics` (https://www.iso.org/open-data.html),
© ISO, the International Organization for Standardization, under the Open Data Commons Attribution License
v1.0 (ODC-By 1.0, https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1-0/). `tests/fixtures/code-intel/packs/iso` is
written from them by `tools/iso-catalog.py`. No standard's text is here.
